_comment: Generated by app/card_catalogue.py and updated when cards are created. Regenerate in the native app via Manage cards and sections > Rebuild card catalogue, or run from the repository root: .venv/bin/python app/card_catalogue.py --worker --output app/data/card_catalogue.json. See specs/card_catalogue.qmd for details.

cand_methods.description: Identify modeling methods compatible with the current outcome, predictors and observation structure.

cand_models.description: Choose weightings that yield the desired optimal model(s).

cand_parameters.description: Mark candidate parameters as tuning hyper-parameters.

cand_train.description: Train pipelines across candidate methods and hyper-parameters.

data_coverage.description: Find under- and over-represented intersections of strata, treatments and sensitive groups.

data_homogeneity.description: Examine whether the data drifts through a meaningful observation sequence.

data_import.description: Facilitate the ingestion of data, be it numeric, categorical, textual, temporal or spatial.

data_parallel.description: Compare observations across several variables as a series of lines.

data_provenance.description: Diagrammatically show the sequence of operations.

data_strata.description: Compare numeric distributions across strata with violin or box plots and ANOVA.

data_structure.description: Distinguish temporal, spatial and textual content from the organization of observations.

data_tabulation.description: List, search and export the data.

miss_impute.description: Statistically impute missing predictor values and evaluate these imputations.

miss_informative.description: Assess the predictive information of each predictor's missing values.

miss_manual.description: Review missingness branches and supply optional, typed replacements.

miss_map.description: Map missing values across variables and observations looking for excessive missingness.

miss_placeholders.description: Detect missing-value placeholders and replace with NA.

miss_rules.description: Visualise Association Rules that describe patterns of missingness.

miss_sets.description: Visualise sets of variables that are missing together.

miss_type.description: Assess whether each variable's missingness is random or not.

model_candidates.description: Compare tuned configurations and model methods using performance, error risk and observed prediction speed.

obs_balance.description: Assess the target's imbalance and adjust it through reweignting or resampling.

obs_cluster_profile.description: Explain cluster memberships using an interpretable tree and held-out fidelity scores.

obs_clusters.description: Compare cluster memberships at the incoming K and optionally add Partition, Mixture and DBSCAN labels as nominal stratifiers.

obs_dependence.description: Are observations ordered in time or repeated within entities, and is serial dependence detectable?

obs_k_clusters.description: Assess cluster counts using seven clustering families and two resampling evaluations and record a number-of-clusters decision for downstream cluster analysis.

obs_outliers.description: Compare complementary outlier scores to investigate unusual observations and disagreements between methods.

obs_resample.description: Choose a prediction goal; assigned roles determine evaluation splits.

obs_weighting.description: Inspect weight components, effective weight concentration and zero weights; optionally reshape weights.

system_log.description: List recent logged messages, warnings and errors.

table_report.description: Interactively report on the data's structure.

var_cardinality.description: Profile the number of distinct values and highlight variables to review.

var_continuous.description: Inspect sorted decimal variables for discontinuities.

var_correlation.description: Visualise the associations between pairs of variables using various methods.

var_dissimilar.description: Explore the family tree of variables visualized as a hierarchy chart.

var_encode.description: Encode nominal, Code, Ordered, Cyclic, Logical and Basket predictors through sklearn pipeline steps.

var_modify.description: Modify variable characteristics such as name, data-type, and order.

var_nominal.description: Review and commit nominal label corrections and rare-level pooling.

var_pairs.description: Explore pairs of variables using charts suited to their semantic types.

var_roles.description: Assign variables to roles they will have in the current analysis.

var_select.description: Learn a subset of variables via shadow selection.

var_text_encode.description: Generate numeric text predictors using vocabulary, sentiment, embeddings, latent semantics and text characteristics.

var_time_encode.description: Generate numeric and cyclic time predictors before Variable encoding.

var_transform.description: Transform the location, spread, and shape of continuous numeric variables.
